analysis.session_summary: The full trading day was a USD and GBP outperformance tape: USD strength +0.202% after JOLTS beat 7.52M vs 7.15M; GBP strength +0.232% with no domestic catalyst. AUD was the weakest at -0.365% despite an inline RBA 4.85% and a press conference with no forecast score. Geopolitical headlines produced sharp legs but all were too weak to own individual moves.

themes.evidence: JOLTS beat forecast 7.52M vs 7.15M and USD basket added 0.089% impulse; DXY +0.138%
AUD strength -0.365%; Cash Rate inline 4.85% but AUD fell 0.251%; RBA press conference -0.093% unscored
US military strike, Qatari MOU, and Iranian 'no agreement' headlines caused legs but were too weak to own moves; VIX +2.343%

currency_drivers.USD: JOLTS beat 7.52M vs 7.15M delivered a normal 0.089% USD impulse.
currency_drivers.EUR: No domestic catalyst; EUR closed at its best, +0.11% strength.
currency_drivers.JPY: No catalyst; attempt rejected and gave back 100%, ending -0.225%.
currency_drivers.GBP: No own releases; held its range as strongest at +0.232%.
currency_drivers.AUD: RBA cash rate inline 4.85%, yet AUD fell 0.251%; press conference unscored.
currency_drivers.CAD: BOC Macklem was muted, CAD basket moved -0.001% inside noise.
currency_drivers.CHF: Swiss CPI beat 0.2% vs 0.0% gave CHF +0.229% impulse that mostly faded.
currency_drivers.NZD: No catalyst; recovered 69% of earlier selling to end +0.033%.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD chopped through eight legs and closed -10.2 pips (-0.091%) as USD strength from the JOLTS beat overcame EUR's late firmness; no leg had a single clear catalyst.

polarity_reads.read: Inline 4.85% but AUD weakened 0.251%, suggesting the market had priced a more hawkish RBA tone and was long AUD.
Unscored: AUD fell 0.093% without a forecast surprise; tone or positioning drove selling.
Normal: 0.2% vs 0.0% beat produced CHF +0.229%, strong inflation sensitivity.
Normal: beat 7.52M vs 7.15M gave USD +0.089%, confirming labor data supports USD.
Muted: -0.001% basket inside noise; no fresh CAD information.
